errors.message: The address written here is computed as GPIO_FUNC_OUT_SEL_CFG_BASE + 4*5 (macro defined line 70-72) and is NOT an address that literally appears in the supplied register map. The map only enumerates GPIO_FUNC0_OUT_SEL_CFG_REG (0x3FF44530) and GPIO_FUNC1_OUT_SEL_CFG_REG (0x3FF44534) for this register family -- indices 2-39 are not individually listed, so 0x3FF44544 is extrapolated from a 4-byte stride assumption rather than confirmed against the map. (The stride itself is well-supported by the GPIO_FUNC254/255_IN_SEL_CFG_REG pair in the same map, 0x3FF44528 -> 0x3FF4452C, but that is indirect corroboration, not a direct entry for this address.) Per audit rule 1, every absolute address written to must exist in the map or be a known dependent register; this one does not.

The read-modify-write at lines 113-117 clears/sets only the MCU_SEL[14:12] and FUN_IE[9] fields before writing the value back. It does not explicitly clear reserved bits [31:15] (per the register map's reserved_bits list for IO_MUX_GPIO5_REG). If those bits ever read back non-zero, this RMW would silently re-assert them on write, violating the map's reserved_bits_note that reserved bits 'should be written as 0'.
